contractEnforcements.hardeningScope: 6 hardening test files under tests/e2e/ that ASSERT production-quality invariants. NO new production renderer module is added. The hardening tests work as a static + logic-level audit gate that fails closed when any documented quality bar regresses.
contractEnforcements.electronBoundary: hardening-01 verifies main.js webPreferences (contextIsolation:true, nodeIntegration:false, allowRunningInsecureContent unset, webSecurity unset to false, experimentalFeatures unset, enableRemoteModule unset, nodeIntegrationInWorker unset, nodeIntegrationInSubFrames unset) and preload.js minimal surface (contextBridge only; no ipcRenderer / fs / child_process / net / http / https / os; no eval; no new Function). Also verifies renderer/index.html declares a CSP meta and does not pull external script src.
contractEnforcements.storageFailure: hardening-02 verifies case-store remove() requires {confirm:true} (destructive guard), backend.transact() rejection produces BACKEND_REJECTED + no partial write, oversized record (>maxRecordBytes) is rejected without crashing the engine.
contractEnforcements.noStaleUI: hardening-03 exercises the harness assertNoStaleCaseRef gate across 7 synthetic transition scenarios: coherent state passes; stale lastSession.sourceCaseId / cachedCaseId throws; mixed stale+coherent throws.
contractEnforcements.largeLibrary: hardening-04 seeds 200 cases, asserts case-store.list returns all N entries deterministically, F1 migration treats them as noop=N with zero rejection/failure, F1 detect reports records=atTarget=N.
contractEnforcements.xssInjection: hardening-05 scans renderer/js for unsafe DOM API usage (no variable-RHS innerHTML/outerHTML assignment; no document.write / writeln; no new Function with variable arg). Also scans renderer/index.html: every x-html binding must be a function call into a named helper (not a raw variable / property access).
contractEnforcements.supplyChain: hardening-06 verifies package.json has no runtime dependencies (Electron-only app); devDependencies limited to {electron, electron-builder}; npm scripts use only local toolchain; no .env / .env.local committed; .gitignore excludes node_modules/ and artifacts/. No bare third-party require in renderer/js.
contractEnforcements.noProductionCodeChange: F3 ships ZERO new production renderer/js module. All hardening is test-side validation that the existing production code (R3.0B/C/D/E + F1 engine) already satisfies the quality bar. R3.0B persistence schemas NOT modified.
